note: Repository secrets that workflows reference, and which an operator must provision.
Checked by scripts/check_workflow_secret_prerequisites.py, which runs on pull requests.
That gate proves the requirement is DECLARED and REVIEWED. It does not prove the secret
exists: reading repository secret metadata needs admin scope, which CI does not hold.
A green run of this gate is therefore not evidence that a workflow will succeed.
post_merge_only marks a secret referenced only by workflows that do not trigger on
pull_request, so nothing can exercise that dependency before merge. This is the shape
that let publish-ghcr.yml fail closed on every push to main for two consecutive merges
after 62774ef, because no pull request could observe it.

secrets.name: OKR_SAAS_ATTESTATION_SECRET
secrets.purpose: Provider attestation key for the SaaS Phase 1 entry evidence bundle, read by scripts/check_saas_phase1_evidence.py.
secrets.remediation: Provisioned together with the Phase 1 evidence bundle, which is currently BLOCKED and records no selected provider.

secrets.name: OKR_RUNTIME_ENV_DOTENV
secrets.purpose: Runtime environment file consumed by the release runtime gate.
secrets.remediation: Provision the runtime dotenv for the target environment before running the gate.

secrets.name: SAAS_DATABASE_URLS_JSON
secrets.purpose: Tenant database connection strings consumed by the SaaS migration workflow.
secrets.remediation: Provision before any SaaS migration run; the workflow is manual.

secrets.name: SAAS_PROVISIONING_STATE_JSON
secrets.purpose: Provisioning state consumed by the SaaS migration workflow.
secrets.remediation: Provision before any SaaS migration run; the workflow is manual.

secrets.name: TOPOLOGY_BASE_URL

secrets.remediation: Provision per environment before collecting topology evidence.

secrets.name: TOPOLOGY_USERNAME
secrets.purpose: Credential for the topology evidence endpoint.
secrets.remediation: Provision per environment before collecting topology evidence.

secrets.name: TOPOLOGY_PASSWORD
secrets.purpose: Credential for the topology evidence endpoint.
secrets.remediation: Provision per environment before collecting topology evidence.

secrets.name: DEPLOY_HOST
secrets.purpose: Deployment target host for docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: Legacy docker-deploy path. NOTE: this workflow references two overlapping naming families (DEPLOY_* and SSH_*/HOST/USERNAME/RELEASE_*), which suggests dead configuration; reconciling them is a separate cleanup and was not done here.

secrets.name: DEPLOY_USER
secrets.purpose: Deployment SSH user for docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: See DEPLOY_HOST; overlaps the SSH_USER family.

secrets.name: DEPLOY_KEY
secrets.purpose: Deployment SSH key for docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: See DEPLOY_HOST; overlaps the SSH_KEY family.

secrets.name: DEPLOY_DIR
secrets.purpose: Deployment directory for docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: See DEPLOY_HOST; overlaps REMOTE_DEPLOY_DIR.

secrets.name: ENABLE_SSH_DEPLOY
secrets.purpose: Toggles the SSH deployment path in docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: See DEPLOY_HOST.

secrets.name: RELEASE_WEB_IMAGE
secrets.purpose: Web image reference deployed by docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: See DEPLOY_HOST.

secrets.name: RELEASE_BFF_IMAGE
secrets.purpose: BFF image reference deployed by docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: See DEPLOY_HOST.

secrets.name: REMOTE_DEPLOY_DIR
secrets.purpose: Remote deployment directory for docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: See DEPLOY_HOST; overlaps DEPLOY_DIR.

secrets.name: SSH_HOST
secrets.purpose: SSH host for docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: See DEPLOY_HOST; overlaps DEPLOY_HOST and HOST.

secrets.name: SSH_USER
secrets.purpose: SSH user for docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: See DEPLOY_HOST; overlaps DEPLOY_USER and USERNAME.

secrets.name: SSH_KEY
secrets.purpose: SSH private key for docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: See DEPLOY_HOST; overlaps DEPLOY_KEY.

secrets.name: HOST
secrets.purpose: Purpose not established from the workflow text alone; it is read by docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: Recorded as unestablished rather than guessed. Resolve during the docker-deploy reconciliation noted on DEPLOY_HOST.

secrets.name: USERNAME
secrets.purpose: Purpose not established from the workflow text alone; it is read by docker-deploy.yml.
secrets.remediation: Recorded as unestablished rather than guessed. Resolve during the docker-deploy reconciliation noted on DEPLOY_HOST.
